Indian cities are rethinking urban mobility as delivery operators rebuild their last-mile fleets.

Demand has grown faster in the India electric vehicle market than in any comparable segment, and charging access is now the binding constraint.

Our latest coverage of the electric two-wheelers segment carries the full forecast.

rationale: Idempotency is what makes a retry after a timeout safe. The second call must report a no-op and leave the page equal to the original, not remove anything else.

description: A pair with attempts left and no cool-down may publish.
rationale: The control case for the budget: a gate that refused everything would make every refusal below vacuous.

description: A pair that has used its whole attempt budget is refused.
rationale: A repeated unsafe retry is the failure the budget exists to stop. exhausted is a function of the counts (attempts >= max_attempts), not a flag something must remember to set.

description: A pair inside its cool-down is refused although it has attempts remaining.
rationale: A failed publish marks the pair; trying again immediately is the retry loop. The cool-down refuses it for a period regardless of the count.

description: A pair that is both exhausted and cooling down reports both stable reason codes.
rationale: Reasons are codes, not prose, and an operator wants every reason that applies.

description: A cool-down that has already elapsed no longer blocks the pair.
rationale: The cool-down must end; a pair that stayed refused forever would turn a safety pause into a permanent block that nobody decided on.

description: Walking one pair through successive failed attempts is allowed until the budget is spent and refused from then on.
rationale: The sequence makes the stopping point explicit: with a budget of three, the fourth request is the first refusal. Repeating an unsafe publish forever is impossible.

description: An exhausted pair does not block a different target on the same source, or the same target from a different source.
rationale: The budget is keyed by (source, target). A source-wide or target-wide counter would let one bad link freeze every other link on a page.

description: With a budget of one, a single recorded attempt exhausts the pair.
rationale: max_attempts is a setting. A hard-coded 3 would keep allowing the second attempt here, which is exactly what this case detects.
